Chapter 426: Chapter 4: Lin Yuan’s Arrival (Please Subscribe)_2

The two Eighth Rank Alien Species didn’t know that most of Lin Yuan’s time and energy had been devoted to perfecting the Eighth Stage Martial Tao and contemplating the Evolutionary Path.

If he fully immersed himself in understanding the core model of the Space Rules, the explosive growth of the inner world would have increased by a large margin.

“Hm?”

“The Peak Master wants to let us out?”

“We have already arrived at the Milky Way Main Star.”

Hongpi and the alien with green eyes showed a slight change in their expressions as they received the message from Lin Yuan.

...

In a flash,

the two of them disappeared from the inner world.

…

Milky Way Main Star, Central Palace.

Lin Yuan sat on the throne, looking down at Chun Bo and Jia Li.

The next moment,

Hongpi and the alien with green eyes appeared in the great hall.

“These are the subordinates under the Star Lord?”

Seeing Hongpi and the green-eyed alien, Chun Bo and Jia Li were overwhelmed with shock.

Eighth Rank.

Both of them were at the Eighth Rank.

Chun Bo and Jia Li’s eyelids twitched involuntarily.

Newly advanced to the Eighth Rank, yet possessing two subordinates of the Eighth Rank, such a move was simply…

Do they really think Eighth Rank powerhouses are like cabbages on the side of the road? Available in abundance?

Chun Bo and Jia Li recognized once again the fearsomeness of Lin Yuan’s background. How much affection did the Chikun Star Lord have for him?

“The four of you will henceforth be responsible for many affairs within the Milky Way Star Region,” Lin Yuan said.

“Yes.”

Chun Bo and Jia Li responded immediately.

“Yes.”

Hongpi and the green-eyed alien also responded in kind.

“By the way, I need the detailed information on those special beings and Alien Lone Walkers in the current star region, as well as their actions over the years, the more detailed the better,” Lin Yuan stated.

Having become the Star Lord of a star domain, Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t allow anything beyond his control to exist within his domain.

Those special beings and Alien Lone Walkers fell within Lin Yuan’s priority focus.

“Yes.”

Chun Bo and Jia Li bowed and said.

…

After the four left,

only Lin Yuan remained in the palace.

“My current strength… In terms of combat power, I have thoroughly reached the peak of the Eighth Rank, right? Perhaps even among the strongest below the Eighth Rank Invincible?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Just the inner world spanning seventy thousand miles in radius alone was sufficient to elevate Lin Yuan’s combat prowess to the peak of the Eighth Rank.

Moreover, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path that Lin Yuan practiced was particularly adept at fighting, and overpowering stronger opponents with weaker strength was as easy as turning one’s hand.

Why could the Martial Path Evolutionary Path overwhelm the two top Eighth Rank Evolutionary Paths on the Chikun Evolution Rankings at the Seventh Rank level?

Potential might be one aspect, but in terms of combat power, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path displayed an overwhelming advantage.

From the First Tier Chapter to the Seventh Rank Chapter, and now to the Eighth Layer Part that Lin Yuan had created, each step of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was derived from Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, striving for perfection in every detail.

“Below the Eighth Rank Invincible, I have few rivals. Even if I encounter an Eighth Rank Invincible, as long as I don’t foolishly clash head-on and choose to flee instead, I shouldn’t have any problems,” Lin Yuan assessed himself.

Those at the Eighth Rank Invincible master a Cosmic Force, placing their combat power above the Eighth Rank, but with Lin Yuan’s current means of preservation, at least he wouldn’t be like Ou Yin, unable to withstand even a single move.

In terms of soul defense, Lin Yuan had the Eighth Rank soul defense treasure to guard him, the “Magic Jade Mark” to protect him, and a Spirit Will almost reaching fourteen thousand points.

Even against soul-type Eighth Rank Invincible Evolvers, Lin Yuan believed he could withstand dozens of moves without dying.

For physical defense, Lin Yuan had Eighth Rank armor to protect his body and the Physical Body Divine Ability “Blood Rebirth.”

Especially the latter; as long as Lin Yuan’s physical body wasn’t instantly crushed to nothingness, he effectively had an immortal body capable of quickly “reborn.”

With these two methods of safeguarding his life, Lin Yuan might not be a match for an Eighth Rank Invincible, but it wouldn’t be easy for an Eighth Rank Invincible to kill him either.

Especially now that the Milky Way Star Region had been incorporated into the Human Civilization Territory, Lin Yuan could, if he wished, summon a large number of human Eighth Rank Evolvers in a short time.

…

Several days later.

Chun Bo and Jia Li delivered the intelligence on those special beings and Alien Lone Walkers in the Milky Way Star Region.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan carefully reviewed the information.

“These special beings are really too arrogant,” Lin Yuan said after reading, shaking his head slightly.

For those special lives birthed from the cosmos, it’s instinct to consider everything within the universe as their possessions.

Especially that being named ‘Ao Du,’ who, every so often, needs to devour planets. Resource planets? Life planets?

They are all mere dishes for ‘Ao Du.’

Such behavior became most rampant after the Shadow Tribe retreated and human civilization was about to take over, even consuming dozens of life planets in a row.

Life planets, suitable for living, hold extremely high strategic significance for human civilization.

Only with a large population base, can human civilization give birth to all sorts of geniuses.

And those resource planets… most resource planets can’t compare in value to life planets of the same level.

But a minority of resource planets contain precious ores and rare treasures, like that dead resource star fought over by the Wangyue Starfield and the Golden Dragon Star Domain.

If the kind of precious ore it contains is fully mined, it would be worth ten thousand cubic universe crystals.

Such a huge sum of cosmic crystals made the Golden Dragon Star Domain green with envy, tangling with the Wangyue Starfield in a contested struggle.

“Mine.”

“Those resource planets, life planets, they are all mine.”

Lin Yuan’s brows knitted tightly; as a Star Lord, he could claim a small portion of all the resource planets within the boundaries of his star domain, even though they belonged to human civilization.

And those life planets, soon human civilization would embark on widespread migration toward the Milky Way Star Region. At such a time, the more life planets, the greater the benefits.

“This Ao Du cannot be allowed to remain,” Lin Yuan decided in his heart.

The Shadow Tribe was wary of Ao Du’s strength and background, but Lin Yuan didn’t care.

Human civilization, waging wars in all eight directions, had never feared anyone.

“I will deal with it personally.”

Lin Yuan stood up and walked out of the palace.

Ao Du was an Eighth Rank special life, nearly reaching the peak of the Eighth Rank. Moreover, Ao Du had deep connections with another Eighth Rank special life; they both lived on the same planet.

In the current Milky Way Star Region, only Lin Yuan had the strength to face ‘Ao Du.’

…

Upon the vast planet.

The huge meat mountain frowned upon watching the blood-colored octopus slowly return from outside the planet.

“Ao Du, I’ve already told you to be more careful lately, try not to go out. That Milky Way Star Lord is probably close now,” the gigantic meat mountain said gravely.

“What will you do if you annoy that Milky Way Star Lord by going out at a time like this?”

It wasn’t afraid of that Milky Way Star Lord.

But it did fear the Chikun Star Lord behind him?

And even more so, the Human Civilization Alliance behind him.

“I, a mighty special life, what’s wrong with devouring a few planets?” Ao Du said nonchalantly.

Lately, it truly had been low-key, no longer devouring life planets.

But it still had to devour resource planets; without the massive energy contained within them, Ao Du’s advancement to the Fourth Stage of the Eighth Rank would be indefinitely delayed.

“But what if the Milky Way Star Lord finds out? What will you do then?”

The colossal meat mountain asked.

“Milky Way Star Lord?”

“A mere evolver not even a hundred years old, even if he stepped into the Eighth Rank, how strong could he be?”

“What can he do to us?” Ao Du said with indifference.

“Oh?”

“Milky Way Star Lord is easy to handle, but what about the Chikun Star Lord?”

“And what about the Human Civilization Alliance?”

The colossal meat mountain glanced at Ao Du, “The reason I’ve been telling you to keep a low profile, to be cautious, isn’t because of the Milky Way Star Lord, but because of the Human Civilization Alliance.”

“The Human Civilization Alliance has already included this star domain within its territory. If we want to live comfortably, we have to watch the faces of the Human Civilization Alliance.”

“As for that Milky Way Star Lord, what’s he even worth?”

The voice of the huge meat mountain thundered.

“Relax, I just devoured a few resource planets. If that Milky Way Star Lord dares to come…”

Ao Du was silent for a moment, then began to speak.

However.

He hadn’t finished speaking when his expression subtly changed.

The massive meat mountain life seemed to sense something as well, its expression suddenly shifting.

“Who’s there?”

Outside the planet, a man clothed in blue armor, his eyes calm, stood with his hands behind his back, looking down from on high, and quietly gazing at Ao Du and the gigantic meat mountain, smilingly said:

“Tell me, what do you plan to do if the Milky Way Star Lord dares to come?”

Before the words ended.

The man extended his right hand, ripples of space began to undulate, and the originally massive planet twisted and shrank violently, ultimately becoming the size of a palm and was caught in the man’s hand.

Ao Du and the colossal meat mountain life, at this moment, became two ants, filled with fear as they looked up at the titan who loomed above them from the heavens.
